title: Add post-cleaning action splitting pass for long bullets

requirements.summary: Implement a second processing pass that runs after initial note cleaning and formatting but before displaying output in the Clean Notes section. This pass should detect bullet points containing more than 10 words with multiple academic action phrases and no commas or conjunctions, then split them into multiple meaningful action-based bullet points based on noun-action sequence patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Second processing pass runs after initial cleaning/formatting but before display
Detects bullets with 10+ words, multiple action phrases, and no commas/conjunctions
Splits detected bullets into multiple action-based bullets preserving full meaning
Example: 'Helps in gas exchange in lungs removal of waste substances from cells distribution of nutrients in the body.' becomes three separate bullets
Final output displays only after second-pass processing completes

file_operations.description: Add a new function `applyActionSplittingPass` that takes formatted bullet points as input and returns processed bullet points with action-based splitting applied. This function should: detect bullets with 10+ words that contain multiple academic action phrases (helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance) and no commas or conjunctions; identify action phrase boundaries using verb changes, noun phrase starts, and functional academic keywords; split each detected action phrase into a separate bullet point while preserving compound scientific terms; return the processed array of bullet points. Integrate this function into the existing formatting pipeline for 'points' and 'definition' modes only, ensuring it runs after initial cleaning/formatting but before the formatted text is returned to the UI.

Update the formatting logic to ensure the action splitting pass from notesCleanerFormat.ts is applied only when formatMode is 'points' or 'definition'. The second processing pass should execute after the initial cleaning/formatting completes but before the cleaned text is displayed in the Clean Notes output section. Ensure the UI remains unchanged and that the output only displays after both passes complete.

requirements.summary: Apply the action splitting logic only to Convert Paragraph to Points and Definition Style Format modes. Do not apply it to other formatting modes or affect heading detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Action splitting only applies when Convert Paragraph to Points is selected
Action splitting only applies when Definition Style Format is selected

file_operations.description: Ensure the action splitting pass is conditionally applied only when formatMode is 'points' or 'definition'. Do not modify heading detection logic or apply splitting to 'paragraph' or 'bullets' modes. The function should preserve all existing functionality for other formatting modes without changes.

requirements.summary: Identify action phrase boundaries using verb changes, noun phrase starts, and functional academic keywords including: helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance. Split each detected action phrase into a separate bullet point while preserving compound scientific terms.
acceptanceCriteria: Algorithm detects action phrase boundaries using verb changes
Algorithm recognizes noun phrase starts as boundaries
Algorithm identifies academic keywords: helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance
Each action phrase becomes a separate bullet point
Compound scientific terms are not split apart
Full meaning of each phrase is preserved in the split

file_operations.description: Implement the action phrase boundary detection algorithm within the `applyActionSplittingPass` function. The algorithm should: identify academic action keywords (helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance); detect verb changes and noun phrase starts as splitting boundaries; preserve compound scientific terms (e.g., 'gas exchange', 'waste substances', 'immune system') by recognizing multi-word technical phrases; split the bullet into separate action-based bullets while maintaining the full meaning of each phrase. Use pattern matching and word-level analysis to ensure accurate splitting without breaking scientific terminology.
